title: Report the checks that frontmatter parse failure prevented instead of printing a green line for each
description: Report the checks that frontmatter parse failure prevented instead of printing a green line for each
acceptance_criteria: When a spec's frontmatter cannot be parsed, `specsync check` reports the source-file, DB-table, required-section, and dependency checks as skipped rather than printing a green result line for each of the four. A spec whose frontmatter is valid continues to report all four normally: the same body with valid frontmatter still reports every genuinely missing required section, and a declared table absent from the schema is still reported as missing. Exit status is unchanged — invalid frontmatter remains an error.
